_comment: Land that is in scope although the border-density rule would not find it.
generate_provinces.py calls a land region 'drawn' when it sits in the dense
magenta network of state borders (worldgen.land_provinces.drawn_mask). That
finds the Old World and, since 2026-10-12, Ulthuan's main island. It cannot
find an island with no interior border, or a small cap cut off a mainland by
one border stroke. Those are listed here.
Authored 2026-10-12 from Chris's markup sources/newly_in_scope.png (a
temporary file: everything he covered in red is in scope, 'Ulthuan and a
bunch of High Elven colonies'). This file replaces that image; nothing reads
the image.
An addition marks land regions by 'box' or by 'points' (canvas px, 8192x3616):
box    [x0, y0, x1, y1): a region is taken when more than half of its
pixels lie inside. Used where the red covered a whole island group.
points [[x, y], ...]: the region holding each point is taken. Used where
the red was a 50 px dot on an island bigger than the dot, and for
the two caps at the Gates of Calith. A point on water is an error.
A region taken here is cut into provinces like any drawn state and takes the
addition's realm; its realm is never voted from the strategic-regions
painting. 'name' is a handle for logs, not a display name and not a canon
claim: the 'label' in each note is what the reprojected globe prints there.
'realms' declares each realm an addition may use: its map_data/state_regions
file stem and the common/strategic_regions/<continent>_strategic_regions.txt
file its region_<realm> block is written to. Colonies take the realm of the
land they sit beside (Chris, 2026-10-12: 'by geography'). These realms hold
only the in-scope pieces; the rest of each continent stays in the
out-of-scope catch-all region.

additions.name: ulthuan
additions.note: Ulthuan and the islands round it (label: ULTHUAN, SHIFTING ISLES). The main island's states are also found by border density; the box brings in the islets and gives every one of them the ulthuan realm.

additions.name: east_lustria_island
additions.note: One island off Lustria's east coast (label: VOLCANIC ISLANDS).

additions.name: isles_of_dusk
additions.note: Two islands off Lustria's southern tip (label: ISLES OF DUSK).

additions.name: isle_of_dawn
additions.note: One island off the Southlands' southern tip (label: ISLE OF DAWN).

additions.name: south_east_southlands_island
additions.note: One island south-east of the Southlands (label reads TOL ELASOR).

additions.name: east_southlands_isles
additions.note: The island group off the Southlands' east coast (label: STARS ARCHIPELAGO). Two red marks, one box. Realm is the nearest coast; Ind is the other candidate.

additions.name: gates_of_calith
additions.note: The two caps Chris cut with border strokes either side of the strait (label: GATES OF CALITH). They are two regions, so two states, unless he merges them in land_region_merges.json.

additions.name: lost_isles_of_elithis
additions.note: The two large islands east of Khuresh (label: LOST ISLES OF ELITHIS). Realm is the nearest named land; Nippon is the other candidate.
